outcome: Massive hemorrhage (bleeding ≥ 200 ml) during dilatation and curettage
cohort: 187 Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients admitted to a tertiary referral hospital between February 2020 and July 2022
finding: A scoring model based on MRI signs (cesarean section diverticulum area, uterine scar thickness, and gestational sac diameter) can predict massive hemorrhage during dilatation and curettage in patients with cesarean scar pregnancy.
